motion_and_effects.scroll_reveal: Staggered fade-up line reveal with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion_and_effects.hover_effects: Micro scale [1.02], subtle border glow shift, shadow elevation

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers for all buttons, links, inputs, cards, accordions, and toasts

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute Phase 1 to Phase 5 fully without skipping any functional logic.
Implement language switching toggle (Bengali/English UI labels state).
Use Framer Motion for masked line-by-line hero reveal and scroll animations.
Ensure all interactive form inputs use custom Shadcn UI / Radix primitives with sonner toasts.
Ensure proper data-testid on every clickable or inspectable element.
Import Google Fonts specified in typography.google_fonts_url in index.html or index.css.
Do NOT use generic white background or unstyled containers. Keep the dark editorial aesthetic consistent.
